response: The main aim of a Phase I clinical trial is to check for safety and tolerability. This phase involves assessing potentially dangerous side effects and unpleasant symptoms (e.g., headache, nausea) in a small number of healthy volunteers (40-60) who are exposed to increasing doses of the drug. These trials are carried out in specialized clinical facilities and are placebo-controlled, randomized, and double-blind.
